Question 15
?

The population P of mosquitos in a particular region increases with time. The rate of change of the population is proportional to the square of the population. What differential equation describes the rate of change of the population of mosquitos at time t?

a
dPdt=kP,k>0
b
dPdt=−kP2,k>0
c
dPdt=−kP,k>0
d
dPdt=kP2,k>0
e
dPdt=kP2,k>0
